rule: Use a skill for instructed procedures, a hook for lifecycle reactions, a plugin for tools or services, and a mod only for live engine or terminal replacement.

packages.why_mod: Replaces live task-entry routing and context assembly, and exports bounded delegation preparation to the recovery policy.
Replaces live escalation and delegation dispatch with failure classification, eligible-tool, advisory-route, and Contributor-outage choices.
Owns live workflow selection, contract gates, candidate checks, and task decisions through generic host services and bounded receipts.
Replaces the live terminal workspace, render sites, key actions, and streamed activity presentation.

Owns the Claude CLI model catalog, request translation and ask_claude delegation over a host-approved provider service while the native host executes every tool and keeps permissions, accounting and cancellation.
Selects owned optional tools at the native per-request boundary from the current host checkpoint; a static skill or plugin cannot change that exposure for each task step.
Selects bounded language-specific verification commands for the current candidate snapshot and relevant inputs during a live task.

Owns the Chess.com preset, the /chess open, hide and end flow and the coding-turn notices over the omd.browser service; the browser view, input and the user-only session stay in omd-browser; installed inactive in OMD+.
Builds a source-bound repository graph and compares approved dependency-boundary baselines during a live task through generic workspace and store operations.
Keeps proposals inert until explicit command activation, then uses revision-checked store state and source evidence to manage a task-visible guideline selection.
Refreshes source-bound repository facts against the current workspace and stores revision-checked evidence for live task reuse.
Discovers and expands source-bound project prompts and skills against the current workspace during a live task.
Presents version-bound repository graph neighbors and source-linked evidence in the live terminal through generic workspace and rendering operations.
Replaces the live terminal inspector dialog and refresh actions while reading generic task, contract, ledger, and install identity state.
Replaces the local compaction decision and injects bounded host checkpoint anchors during a live session.
Owns the live typed task tool, bounded sibling dispatch and result-schema validation while using generic native worker and isolated integration operations.
Registers an explicitly selected native workflow contract and asks the host to restrict delegation when an exact candidate enters final verification.
Drives live native agent spawning, waiting, result consumption, and lifecycle state inside the active task.
Alters admitted model requests and the live response stream, which hooks and plugins cannot replace.
Runs a granted program outside the session sandbox with host-supervised lifecycle and revocation.
Replaces live compaction and context recovery policy while reading host-owned checkpoint state.
Replaces the model, provider, and reasoning preset selected at the live request boundary.
Replaces live terminal layout, theme, render templates, and key handling.
Registers and restricts a host-enforced workflow contract during a live task without owning native guarantees.
Exercises the bounded context observer API only; user-facing guidance belongs in a skill or lifecycle hook.
Exercises tool, command, progress, and durable-state conformance only; a user-facing counter would be a plugin tool.
Exercises input and lifecycle replacement conformance only; a user-facing deterministic guard would be a hook.
Exercises simple tool interception conformance only; user-facing tool policy belongs in a hook or plugin.
Exercises a host-routed service import only; a user-facing service consumer belongs in a plugin.
Exercises a host-routed service export only; a user-facing service belongs in a plugin.
Exercises the pre-upgrade package release for live terminal replacement and state migration.
Exercises current live terminal replacement, interaction, and migrated state.
Exercises the pre-upgrade package release for live routing policy and state migration.
Exercises current live routing, context, coordination, interception, and cross-mod service replacement.
Exercises task-scoped optional tool exposure at each native sampling step.
Exercises bounded live compaction and anchored task context across reload.
Draws the Oh My Diff wordmark and launch status into the terminal header from the read-only launch identity.
Selects the compact native model and reasoning picker presentation while native keeps rows, warnings and persistence.

Adds a live Git sidebar with previews and confirmations over host-owned, fingerprint-checked Git operations, and read-only GitHub pull request and CI status polled on timers through origin-bound HTTP with a package-owned token.
Exercises reusable live workspace read, pre-rename events and host-authorized transactions.

Owns live language-server synchronization, post-edit diagnostic feedback and rename/edit planning through generic host process, workspace and tool-output operations; exports the omd.lsp query service for the code-intelligence view.
Registers an independent virtual resource using the shared sandboxed extension bridge; the provider owns its resource grammar and content.
Demonstrates scoped fact selection and frozen live context reuse, plus commands through the same public bridge.
Owns a bounded completed-turn procedure and result interpretation through the shared accounted review interface.
Uses only a public tool export and a granted generic service request; no live engine replacement.

An independent author package that uses only the 0.2 host primitives: a contract document, receipts, sandboxed commands, workspace listing, durable store and evidence, stream control, built-in controls and a list replacement.
Demonstrates live frozen-workspace review, scoped restrictions, receipts, and resumable agent evidence using only the public mod API.

Owns on-demand, triggered and completed-turn advice, the opt-in important-output observer, independent review prompts, typed result and citation validation, deduplication and selected-context presentation through public accounted review primitives.
Owns lead-requested broad-research admission, bounded briefing and evidence validation using an explicitly granted read-only host worker preset.
Tightens live native approval decisions before hooks and automatic review, which hooks cannot force.
Suggests the rest of a recent prompt as revision-bound ghost text from draft change events, which skills and hooks cannot draw.
Rewrites or refuses pasted draft text through the composer_edit interceptor chain before it reaches the draft.
Approves routine check commands inside a user-delegated native approval grant, which hooks and skills cannot hold.
Refuses or restricts other mods at load and guards host requests under a user-granted policy, which hooks and skills cannot do.
Rewrites slash-command and settings metadata, arguments and writes through host continuations that hooks and skills cannot reach.
Publishes and receives namespaced in-process channel events between live mods.
Asks the user through native text and confirmation prompts from a live command.
Replaces the model-bound request history at each request without changing the transcript.
Appends composable feedback to live tool output before it reaches the model.
Replaces live composer mention ranking inside the terminal.
Keeps thread-scoped state that forks and deletes with the live thread.
Lists the session's built-in and mod slash commands from the live terminal inventory.
Lists the TCP listeners of the current session's background terminals from the live host.
Keeps one state per Git checkout that every OMD session working there shares.
Keeps inline scrollback free of every mod sidebar and header for screen readers and plain terminals.
Renders an imported image inside a live terminal render site and opens links after native confirmation.
Replaces the live terminal layout with splits, tabs, documents and diffs.
Draws an animated raster with pointer hover, drag and an anchored overlay.
Shows the attached-client roster and launches its own text renderer process that joins the session over the client protocol.
Keeps a filterable approval desk beside other sidebars, with a client adapter that answers approvals over the client protocol.
Redraws native terminal components: a custom spinner, framed tool calls, annotated assistant messages and a wrapped question.
Keeps a form, a streamed status and a derived summary on keyed reactive state.
Turns live app-server notifications into terminal notifications with focus state.
Replaces model-visible tool output at the live tool boundary while the host keeps the original.
Drives package controls behind native confirmation from a live terminal panel.
Selects credential-bound routes at the live request boundary.
Merges parallel-safe tool calls of one live response into a single call.
Writes binary evidence and attaches it to the live composer.
Runs a sandboxed interactive shell rendered inside a live terminal pane.
Defines a model-visible tool at run time and refreshes its answer from a keyed timer.
Enrolls origin-bound secrets through native prompts and hands them only to its sidecars.
Runs one-shot completions on configured worker routes under live admission and the ledger.
Defers and re-describes model-visible tool specs per route through the composable tool_specs chain.
Caches, confirms and retries live tool calls through the continuation chain and the turn's tool executor.
Reads the host turn-activity ledger for the live thread.
Watches workspace paths and reports external changes through live terminal notifications.
Starts a live thread bound to a permitted worktree root and shows it in the terminal.

Composes live terminal palettes, backgrounds, composer appearance, greeting settings, a powerline status line from thread notifications and a composer-draft stash through public presentation, composer and app primitives; installed inactive in OMD+.
Matches bounded explicit rules against completed response items and requests a stream stop and retry through response_stream middleware; installed inactive in OMD+.
Owns the Python-facing context, child-agent and refinement API plus a versioned session harness in the model-bound request view; installed inactive in OMD+.
Owns the plan-mode removal policy through public builtins controls (hidden /plan, disabled plan mode, turn-start clamp); installed inactive in OMD+.
Owns the user-typed /continue recovery prompt and a bounded summary built only from the host turn-activity ledger; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the user-typed /preview command, its packaged Markdown renderer, file watches, the inline preview dialog, inline Mermaid drawings of assistant messages and draft image thumbnails above the composer; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the /mods screen, its actions and the first-run card over public package controls and terminal sites; native code keeps trust, confirmation, package authority and /omd recovery; enabled by default in both profiles.

Owns the update notice, the /update dialog, snooze and skip state and the update policy settings (checks, channel, cadence, pin, automatic updates); the installer reads those settings and does the network check and installation; active in OMD Core and OMD+.
Owns the Cursor SDK transport, custom-tool relay of OMD tools, usage settlement log and /cursor diagnostics over a host-approved provider service; installed inactive in OMD+.
Owns the Muse MSP client, approval relay and research tool over a host-approved provider service; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the pane layout, file tree, viewer and shell panes through public layout, terminal, PTY, workspace-transaction and thread-store primitives, ranking tree find through the optional omd.frecency service; installed inactive in OMD+.

Composes the session list, find, quick open and palettes from app-server thread, model and skill inventory, the terminal command inventory and the optional omd.panes, omd.worktrees and omd.frecency services; installed inactive in OMD+.

Creates, switches, integrates and removes task worktrees through fixed Git argument lists, guarded exec writes, native prompts and app-server thread starts bound to registered worktree roots; installed inactive in OMD+.
Owns the notes vault view, wiki-link index, note commands, its own command-argument completion and opt-in agent tools; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns editable file buffers, their rendering, key handling, Git gutter and conflict recovery over public key documents, workspace transactions and watches, composing omd_panes, omd_git and omd_lsp_view through their commands; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the shared-checkout registry, path reservations, handoffs and Git lease in mod state and enforces them for agent patches, Git commands and recognizable shell writes through approval middleware; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the mini presentation of omd mini sessions: hidden inline sites, compact tool summaries, a short prompt, one status segment and the switch request read by the launcher; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the user prompt queue: thread-scoped entries, capture from the draft, edit/reorder/join/send commands, idle draining through host consents and pause on a stopped turn; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns secret and PII detection, sensitive-path rules, reviewed exemptions and salted placeholders as a required model_send policy and approval middleware over the generic final-request stage; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the provider usage HUD: a per-thread request ledger from model_response, cache, cost and quota classification, the Usage and Workers sidebar panels, the usage dialog and the summary the theme draws; installed inactive in OMD+.
Owns the user-invoked code-intelligence view, its request hop, result navigation over the omd.lsp service, file-view diagnostics and the language-server sidebar pane; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns @ mention ranking through the exclusive completion replacement, queues paths from submitted input and learns them at turn start into repository storage and serves the omd.frecency ranking service; installed inactive in OMD+.
Pins Codex's update_plan steps above the composer from turn/plan/updated notifications in a wrapped above_composer site with a collapse key; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns profile selection, setup guidance, paid-route consent and status over host credential flows and routes.select, plus the loopback router that adapts Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages providers; installed inactive in OMD+.

Maps native thread status notifications to Herdr pane reports with the session resume command and releases the pane on exit, through declared environment metadata, exec.run and a granted Unix socket; installed inactive in OMD+.

Owns the MCP server sidebar from startup notifications, per-server status, failed tool calls, the redacted configuration and plugin inventory, confirmed enable/disable writes, reload and composer-drafted upstream codex mcp setup commands; installed inactive in OMD+.
